name: Kayneth Stillwind
summary: In Ashenvale, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire sends a scouting report east from Astranaar. Druid Kayneth Stillwind needs help watching corruption spread through the ancient woods.

sections.title: A Dispatch to the East
sections.body: In Astranaar, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire watches over western Ashenvale. Kayneth Stillwind, a druid at Forest Song in the eastern forest, has asked her to judge the region's security. Shifting wildlife and dark omens along the coasts and through the woods trouble him. So Swiftfire seals her observations in a note and entrusts it to a traveler crossing the dangerous central forest.

sections.title: Watchers at Forest Song
sections.body: The road to Forest Song crosses Nightsong Woods, where satyrs encroach, wildlife turns hostile, and the Horde ventures from the south. At the shrine, Kayneth Stillwind studies the balance of Ashenvale's natural spirits. Swiftfire's report confirms his fear: corruption spreads through the forest, neither confined to one place nor passing quickly. The druids need more help to confront the wickedness taking root.

faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind is at Forest Song, a night elf sanctuary in Nightsong Woods, far east in Ashenvale and north of the main road.
Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire offers it from Astranaar, the night elf settlement in western Ashenvale.
Shindrell's Note reports security along Ashenvale's western coast and around Astranaar's woodlands. The report helps Kayneth Stillwind investigate unnatural corruption in the forest.

faq.q: Why is Kayneth Stillwind investigating the forest?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind fears wickedness is spreading through Ashenvale. As a druid, he seeks Sentinel reports to learn where it is taking hold and preserve nature's balance.

faq.q: Is Forest Song safe for Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: Forest Song is a peaceful Alliance refuge with friendly sentinels and druids. Hostile beasts and corrupted satyrs threaten the surrounding Nightsong Woods, making the journey hazardous.

faq.q: What happens after delivering the note?
faq.answer: After reviewing Shindrell's report, Kayneth investigates the forest's corruption and enlists travelers to act against the blighted forces threatening the region.

angles.text: As a druid, you answer a calling by helping Kayneth Stillwind and the Cenarion Circle heal Ashenvale from spreading demonic and elemental blights.
As a night elf, you share the Sentinels' duty to keep communication open between Astranaar and distant holdings like Forest Song.
As an Alliance traveler, you help maintain communication and defense across Ashenvale, from its center to eastern Nightsong Woods, against wilderness threats and Horde incursions.
